notes.title: Video showing the options on the PC edition now live
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ejreZuO_lxs;full][/previewyoutube]

Infinity Strash: DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai is now available for digital pre-orders. Players who pre-order the game will receive Dai’s special outfit “Legendary Hero” and the Bond Memory “The Hero's Tutor”.

The Digital Deluxe Edition provides the full game download, along with the following bonus items:
• Popp’s special outfit “Legendary Mage”
• Maam’s special outfits “Legendary Priest” and “Legendary Martial Artist”
• Hyunckel’s special outfits “Legendary Swordsman” and “Legendary Warrior”
